author: Huawei
description:
Seismic exploration is getting faster, smarter, and more precise. Working with #Huawei Enterprise, BGP, a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), has upgraded its seismic processing platform with Huawei Kunpeng computing solutions to accelerate processing tasks. 
 
Together, BGP and Huawei are advancing the accuracy and efficiency of oil and gas exploration with innovative technologies, shortening turnaround times and improving seismic imaging quality. Learn more: https://bit.ly/45y34uT #Stories100
title: BGP and Huawei Advance AI-Powered Seismic Exploration for Oil & Gas
